topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: I walked into the room, shadows cast by the flickering neon outside. The rain had set a steady beat against the window, a rhythm I’d heard too many times. She handed me a folded piece of paper, eyes avoiding mine. "I found this in his jacket," she said, voice barely more than a whisper. I unfolded it, the cheap motel paper rough under my fingers. A bucket list, they call it. Travel the world, learn to cook, watch the sunset over the ocean. Each line a promise, each one unmarked, untouched. I folded it back, slower this time. "Kept it well hidden, didn’t he?" I muttered, more to myself than to her. The weight of the unspoken settled between us, heavier than the silence.
